_meta.purpose: Sprint 7.0.2 (incident #5/#6 — docs/SYSTEM_ANALYSIS.md §11): deliberate, committed exceptions to apps.accounting.management.commands.check_chart_health's own --fail-on-findings gate. Never an environment variable, never a silent skip — same pattern as archived-tenant exclusion in add_missing_system_accounts. A finding listed here is still PRINTED by check_chart_health on every run (as an accepted exception, not hidden), it just no longer fails the deploy. Add an entry only when the owner has explicitly decided to accept a specific tenant's chart shape as-is rather than fix it.
